description: This file defines the 'Pool' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which manages concurrent HTTP requests using a request pool with configurable concurrency. It provides methods for creating request pools, handling their promises, and processing batches of requests with callbacks for fulfilled and rejected responses.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: A class to send multiple HTTP requests concurrently with a capped pool size, supporting batch execution and callback handling for fulfilled or rejected requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Pool instance with a client, requests, and configuration options, setting up an iterator that yields promises for each request.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all requests in the pool are completed.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of requests concurrently, returning an array of responses or exceptions, and invokes callbacks for each fulfilled or rejected request.
